name: Hitozuma Baibai -Nakadashi Jutai-
original_name: 人妻売買 -膣内射精受胎-
source:
Suddenly, busty housewives are taken captive by several strange men from off the streets!
Taken into their cars, the women are in for more than they could have ever expected!
What is going to happen to the captured housewives? Watch and find out!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ033282.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
